review_evidence: README states the main formal result that 2n-4 calls suffice for fully connected gossip and describes necessary/self-correcting developments.
Gossip/Basic.lean defines the protocol state/call semantics and proves monotonicity/expertise lemmas; the source contains over 200 declaration-shaped items.
Evaluation and error-related files are formal examples of the definitions rather than generated duplicate artifacts, so no path-prefix exclusion is lossless.
summary: Retain Gossip-in-Lean completely: the repository formalizes gossip protocols and its evaluation/error modules contain useful formal examples and correctness statements.
